_doc: Known-defect ledger for scripts/db-proof/tbHandlerCharacterization.mjs (blueprint Revision 2). EMPTY since E2.

H2 recorded nine defects of the engine at engine_commit (its index.ts SHA-256 is handler_sha256); E1 fixed every one, and E1's gate (this file and the characterization at e1_engine_commit) proved the previous engine reproduced each exact signature on the same fixtures while E1 matched the independent oracle. Those fixtures remain as requirements.

engine_commit and e1_engine_commit name the engines the proofs still run beside the current one: the H1 proof runs them on the pre-S2 chain; the characterization proves both are refused at their first write once S2 is applied (X8).
A new defect is registered here with its exact signature and an independent oracle; a probe that matches the oracle (fixed) or any other value fails the gate.
